summary: fix(settings): disable signup code form after verifySession succeeds
description:
Because:

* A paste submits the sign-up code, and the form is enabled again
  while hardNavigate waits, so a click re-sends a redeemed code

This commit:

* Disables the confirm code form after verifySession succeeds
* Enables it again on the paths where the page stays with an error

Closes FXA-15077
